t: A Christian highland kingdom ruled by the Solomonic dynasty, which claimed descent from Solomon and the Queen of Sheba, from 1270 to 1974.
Menelik II's victory over Italy at Adwa in 1896 kept Ethiopia independent and made it a symbol for pan-Africanists worldwide.
An unreformed feudal land system and the concealed Wollo famine brought down Haile Selassie and the monarchy in 1974.
dyk: Ethiopia's survival in 1543 owed much to some 400 Portuguese musketeers, whose firepower helped Emperor Galawdewos defeat and kill Ahmad Gran at Wayna Daga.
ev: Yekuno Amlak overthrows the last Zagwe king and founds the Solomonic dynasty
Zara Yaqob defeats the Adal Sultanate at the Battle of Gomit
Ahmad Gran crushes Lebna Dengel at the Battle of Shimbra Kure
Galawdewos, aided by Portuguese musketeers, defeats and kills Ahmad Gran at Wayna Daga
The Zemene Mesafint, the Era of the Princes, begins as regional lords eclipse the emperors
Menelik II routs the Italian army at Adwa, securing Ethiopian independence
Italian forces using aerial bombardment and poison gas capture Addis Ababa
The Derg deposes Haile Selassie; the monarchy is abolished in March 1975
